messages:
alex: quick share — ran a small llm.int8 (bitsandbytes weight-only) bakeoff for vega-13b to check quality vs fp16 and perf on our p4/g5 pools. posting raw notes below
sana: sick, curious about deltas. which evals and configs?
alex: tests: gsm8k (few-shot), lcqa subset (internal mix), and a 500-sample summarization slice. configs: fp16 baseline, bnb-llm.int8 weight-only (default per-layer zero point), batch sizes 1/8/32, seq len 512. run on g5.12xlarge equiv and p4d.
evan: share numbers pls — even quick ones. :eyes:
alex: sure — TL;DR quality hit small but measurable, perf tradeoffs minor on g5, worse on p4d for small batches

-- GSM8K (5-shot) --
fp16: 78.4%
int8-w-only: 76.6%  (delta -1.8)

-- LCQA (short Q/A 1k) --
fp16: 83.1%
int8-w-only: 82.4%  (delta -0.7)

-- Summarization (rougeL avg over 500) --
fp16: 42.8
int8-w-only: 41.7  (delta -1.1)

-- Perf (tokens/sec, seq 512, batch=8) on g5:
fp16: 610 tok/s
int8-w-only: 585 tok/s  (~-4%)

on p4d (batch=1 low-latency):
fp16: 145 tok/s
int8-w-only: 112 tok/s  (~-23%)

bench-bot: ran 3 seeds each, numbers are median. logs: s3://redwood-qa/vega-13b/int8-bnb/1732/

liam: interesting — why worse on p4d for small batches?
maria: likely kernel path. bnb weight-only introduces extra quant-dequant ops on the fast path; when batch=1 there isn't enough compute to amortize. memory bandwidth on p4d may be different.
evan: did you try grouped-quant or any per-channel changes? any fallback bits?
alex: just default bnb llm.int8 weight-only config for this run. next steps planned: try grouped quant params (nbits grouping), try llmint8 alternate kernels, and run p4d with batch=8 to see crossover point. also want to run AWQ/GPTQ for comparison but those need offline rebuilds.
sana: for rollout suggestion — sounds safe for latency-tolerant bulk embedding/summarization routes where batch>8 and cost matters. not for low-latency chat with batch=1. can we get a per-route policy?
maria: yes — add a routing policy: prefer int8 for routes with avg batch >=8 and >100ms SLO, otherwise force fp16. also add quality monitor on GSM8K-like slices to catch >1.5% drop.

alex: quick commands I used:
```
# create bnb int8 model snapshot
python infra/load_model.py --model vega-13b --quantize bnb-llm-int8 --out s3://.../int8/1732
# run eval harness
python eval/run.py --model s3://.../int8/1732 --suites gsm8k,lcqa,summarize --batch 8 --out results.json
```

ops-bot: started canary job target=dedicated-int8-pool size=2 on region us-west-2 for 24h (job id r-1732-c)
liam: can we add a rapid A/B: split 90/10 on query route for longform summarization and monitor latency + rouge?
sana: yeah 90/10 sounds good. also tag logs with quant=bnw-llm.int8 so we can slice in console.
evan: also add model-version pin so fallback to fp16 happens automatically on error. and a graceful degrade to fp16 if avg rouge drop >2% within 1h.
maria: i'll draft the rollout policy. alex can you run the grouped-quant sweep and push results to the same s3 path?
alex: on it. next run will include grouped bitsize 64/128 and per-channel zero-point tweaks. ETA end of day. :thumbsup:
sana: thanks — this is actionable. small quality hit but could be worthwhile in batchy routes. mark as "int8-proposed" in our model onboard doc and assign follow-ups.
bench-bot: note: cache/KV tests still pending — int8 impacts KV transfer size slightly, profiling next.
alex: noted, will include KV perf in next sweep. closing for now, will post updated results in this thread when done. :rocket:
